name: memo-bridge
description: Private MCP for Memo Labs: inspect a Mac and a Netcup VPS read-only, browse registered projects, coordinate parallel AI work sessions on GitHub Issues (workspaces, shared Issue leases, Git-verified checkpoints), and run claimed tasks on the Mac (worktrees, file edits, test/build/lint jobs, commit, push, pull request) without relying on the Sentinel X commercial hub.

interface.shortDescription: Mac + VPS status, work coordination and a Mac runner
interface.longDescription: Inspect the Memo Labs Mac and VPS with fixed read-only probes, list registered projects, and coordinate work between sessions: open a workspace, claim a GitHub Issue through the shared Memo Labs lease ledger, work on the claimed task in an isolated worktree, run the repository's own test/build/lint recipe inside a macOS sandbox (worktree writes only, loopback network only, no private data or credentials; MEMO_BRIDGE_JOB_SANDBOX=off makes jobs owner-equivalent), commit, push and open a pull request. Its tools use no shell and never write a default branch, force-push, merge or deploy. Requires a local Mac runtime, python3, a logged-in gh, and SSH access to the VPS.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the status of my Mac and VPS through Memo Bridge.
